in_marathi.name: इमरान
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Imperial, Commander, King
in_marathi.long_meaning: इमरान हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। From the Persian word ‘Emar’, meaning ‘Imperial, Commander, King’. In Hindu mythology, Imarana is the name of a celestial being, the commander of the army of the god Indra. This name is believed to bestow courage, leadership, and strength upon the bearer.
